_comment: OpenAirInterface: two DUs under one CU (F1 handover), as in doc/handover-tutorial.md. 'gnb' decides F1 (same gnb) vs N2 (different gnb) for the telnet actuator in auto mode. Replace PCIs / NR cell ids with the values of your DU configs. OAI configs give nr_cellid in decimal (nr_cellid = 12345678L), so 'nci' is a decimal number here.
